It is only shadowed/unused on the recurring-event path, so it is not dead code overall — the 'dead variable' claim is factually overstated, and the residual concern (an extra call on one path) is a minor style/perf nit, not a substantive defect.

adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, inside the loop when `credentialId` is present, the code does `const calendar = await getCalendar(calendarCredential);` and then, in the recurring-event branch, it creates `promises` that each do their own `const calendar = await getCalendar(credential);` and uses that inner `calendar` for deletions. The outer `calendar` is not referenced in that recurring branch (it is only used in the non-recurring `else`), so that `await getCalendar(calendarCredential)` is a wasted call in the recurring-cancellation path.
